# select. slot. 1.8.1 Ver. 10 — Miyoo

- The original Miyoo Mini waits for POWER to be released before OnionOS starts its native shutdown, preventing the held button from waking the unit straight back into Slot.
- An orderly OnionOS shutdown clears Slot's launch guard so a quick shutdown cannot be mistaken for a crash and leave the game unseated on the following boot.
